ai_summary: Adiniya Investments Private Limited, a non-promoter, has acquired a 7.13% stake in ACS Technologies Limited by converting a loan into 4,950,495 equity shares via a preferential allotment. This transaction materially strengthens ACS Technologies' balance sheet by reducing debt and increasing equity, while also introducing a new substantial shareholder. A key concern is the significant difference between the undiluted (7.13%) and fully diluted (4.70%) ownership percentages, indicating substantial outstanding convertible securities that could lead to further dilution for all shareholders.
